messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Quick check-in: billing API refactor (ATLS-42) is blocked on the CQRS split review. Jordan, when are you targeting merge?

messages.author: jordan-lee
messages.text: Today or tomorrow — load tests are running now. Will post results here.

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: Heads up: I already removed the v1 endpoints in PR #52. Let's make sure ATLS-42 lands before we tag next release.

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: FYI: PR #49 (Lumen auth tokens v2 migration) is merged. Atlas is now on /api/auth/tokens/v2. The v1 endpoint will sunset June 15 — this was blocking ATLS-56 (premium flag gating). Jordan, you should be unblocked now.

messages.author: jordan-lee
messages.text: Great, picking up ATLS-56 this week. Thanks for the heads up on the dependency.

messages.author: datadog-bot
messages.text: ALERT: billing-api P99 latency in eu-west-1 exceeded 2000ms threshold. Duration: 18 minutes.

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: Found it — it was the EU replica lagging behind after the v1 endpoint removal migration. Replica caught up; latency back to normal. Created ATLS-58 to track post-mortem.

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Good catch. Let's add a canary check for replica lag to the deploy runbook.

title: #atlas-eng: Webhook HMAC fix needs second review

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: PR #54 (webhook HMAC timing fix) is up. Small change but it's in a security path — would appreciate a second set of eyes before merging.

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: On it. LGTM — the monotonic clock approach is the right fix. Approving.

title: #cross-team: Atlas dependency on Lumen auth v2 coordination

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Flagging this for visibility: Atlas merged our auth token v2 migration this week. This unblocks our premium tier work (ATLS-56) and means we're now dependent on Lumen's /api/auth/tokens/v2 in production. @priya-nair — any concerns about rollback plans for v2?

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: v2 is solid — been running in prod since Monday with zero incidents. v1 stays up until June 15 so you have a rollback path. But let's not plan to use it :)

messages.author: jordan-lee
messages.text: Good to know. ATLS-56 is in progress. Premium tier launch targeting end of sprint.

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: One thing worth noting: the v2 token now includes `scopes`. If Atlas is checking scopes client-side for entitlement gating, make sure you're looking at the right field. Happy to pair on it.

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Sprint 14 week summary: ATLS-38 ✅, ATLS-41 ✅, ATLS-42 🔄 (PR merged, Jira not yet closed), ATLS-29 ✅, ATLS-55 ✅. In flight: ATLS-44, ATLS-47, ATLS-56.

messages.author: morgan-park
messages.text: ATLS-44 at 70% coverage. Should close by Monday.

messages.author: jordan-lee
messages.text: ATLS-56 feature flags are coded; waiting on LaunchDarkly config from DevOps.

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: Note on ATLS-42: Jordan merged the PR Friday (PR #51 says 'Closes ATLS-42') but I see the Jira ticket is still showing In Progress. Someone should update it before retro.
